name: PowerDNS Authoritative
author: Netlens
description: Registers your devices in PowerDNS Authoritative Server (4.x): an A record and a reverse (PTR) record for every device Netlens knows and DNS does not, and a changed address for devices whose IP changed (DHCP). Netlens marks every record set it writes with a comment and only changes or removes record sets that carry it, so records made by anything else are never touched.

info.title: Switch on the API (pdns.conf)
info.text: PowerDNS's built-in API needs a key and a web server. Add these lines, restart pdns and keep the port closed to everything but Netlens: the key can change every zone.
info.code:
api=yes
api-key=CHANGE-ME
webserver=yes
webserver-address=0.0.0.0
webserver-allow-from=192.168.0.10/32
webserver-port=8081

config.label: PowerDNS servers
config.help: The primary (or only) server that holds the zones. Secondaries that get the zone by transfer must not be listed.

config.label: TTL for new records (seconds)
config.help: PowerDNS needs a TTL on every record set. A record set that already exists keeps its own.
